fields.description: Issue features local political and civic commentary opposing revival of a general sales tax in Miami and discussing municipal finances and utility rates. Coverage includes gambling and bookmaking enforcement in Greater Miami and Miami Beach, including the closing of booking places following a letter attributed to Fritz Gordon, and discussion of police leadership and possible appointment of H. Leslie Quigg as chief. The issue also highlights Miami Life’s city-wide contest for "Miami's Most Attractive Working Girl," naming Miss Mary Brasher of the Florida Power & Light Company as a preliminary winner, and includes racing news, columns, and local social/running commentary.
